exposure: Exposure levels to the multimodal prenatal health care model (T1, T2, T3)
Exposure to a multimodal prenatal health care model (in-office and telemedicine visits)
Unexposed (T1): Birth delivery between July 1, 2018, and February 29, 2020
Fully exposed (T3): Birth delivery between December 6, 2020, and October 31, 2021
Partially exposed (T2): Birth delivery between March 1, 2020, and December 5, 2020
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates
cohort: 151,464 individuals (mean age 31.3 years) who delivered a live birth or stillbirth at Kaiser Permanente Northern California between July 1, 2018, and October 21, 2021
finding: A multimodal prenatal health care model combining in-office and telemedicine visits performed similarly to in-office only prenatal health care in terms of maternal and neonatal outcomes, supporting its continued use after the pandemic.
